reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Florida
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for violating statutory tenant obligations?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic jurisdiction metadata
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction(florida).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Parties and lease
scenario_landlord(l1).
scenario_tenant(t1).
scenario_rental_agreement(lease1).
scenario_parties_to_lease(lease1, l1, t1).

% "Violating statutory tenant obligations" (FL Stat.  83.52 is referenced by  83.56(2))
% We encode that the tenant materially failed to comply with statutory tenant obligations.
scenario_tenant_material_noncompliance(t1, statute_83_52).

% Classify the noncompliance for purposes of FL Stat.  83.56(2):
% Here, it is curable (i.e., tenant should be given an opportunity to cure).
scenario_noncompliance_curability(t1, statute_83_52, curable).

% Landlord delivered the required written notice specifying noncompliance and warning of termination.
% For curable noncompliance,  83.56(2)(b) requires a 7-day cure notice.
scenario_written_notice_delivered(l1, t1, notice_7_day_cure, statute_83_52).

% Tenant did not cure within 7 days after delivery.
scenario_not_cured_within_7_days(t1, statute_83_52).

% Tenant did not vacate (so eviction/possession is the practical next step after termination).
scenario_tenant_still_in_possession(t1).

% Waiver facts (FL Stat.  83.56(5)(a)):
% Landlord did not accept rent with actual knowledge of this noncompliance for the relevant period.
scenario_landlord_accepted_rent_with_knowledge(l1, t1, statute_83_52, no).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario (the factual statement) is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(florida),
    focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(L),
    scenario_tenant(T),
    scenario_rental_agreement(Lease),
    scenario_parties_to_lease(Lease, L, T),
    scenario_tenant_material_noncompliance(T, statute_83_52),
    scenario_noncompliance_curability(T, statute_83_52, curable),
    scenario_written_notice_delivered(L, T, notice_7_day_cure, statute_83_52),
    scenario_not_cured_within_7_days(T, statute_83_52),
    scenario_tenant_still_in_possession(T),
    scenario_landlord_accepted_rent_with_knowledge(L, T, statute_83_52, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic predicates encoding FL statutes)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  FL Stat.  83.56(5)(a) (2021) - waiver by acceptance of rent with actual knowledge.
  If landlord accepts rent with actual knowledge of tenant noncompliance, landlord waives
  right to terminate for that noncompliance (but not subsequent/continuing noncompliance).

  This program models the basic waiver concept needed to answer the question.
*/
statute_83_56_5a_waiver_by_rent_acceptance(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance) :-
    scenario_landlord_accepted_rent_with_knowledge(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance, yes),
    !.
statute_83_56_5a_waiver_by_rent_acceptance(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Noncompliance) :-
    fail.

% Convenience: not waived (deterministic yes/no-style predicate)
statute_83_56_5a_not_waived(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance) :-
    (   statute_83_56_5a_waiver_by_rent_acceptance(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance)
    ->  fail
    ;   true
    ),
    !.

/*
  FL Stat.  83.56(2) (2021) - tenant material noncompliance (other than nonpayment of rent)
  Landlord may terminate rental agreement after providing appropriate notice:

  (a) Noncurable OR subsequent/continuing within 12 months after written warning:
      written notice specifying noncompliance and intent to terminate; tenant has 7 days to vacate.

  (b) Curable:
      written notice specifying noncompliance and warning that failure to correct within 7 days
      will result in termination.
*/
statute_83_56_2_termination_right(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance) :-
    %  83.56(2)(a): noncurable (modeled here as "incurable")
    scenario_tenant_material_noncompliance(Tenant, Noncompliance),
    scenario_noncompliance_curability(Tenant, Noncompliance, incurable),
    scenario_written_notice_delivered(Landlord, Tenant, notice_7_day_vacate, Noncompliance),
    statute_83_56_5a_not_waived(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance),
    !.
statute_83_56_2_termination_right(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance) :-
    %  83.56(2)(b): curable + not corrected within 7 days after notice
    scenario_tenant_material_noncompliance(Tenant, Noncompliance),
    scenario_noncompliance_curability(Tenant, Noncompliance, curable),
    scenario_written_notice_delivered(Landlord, Tenant, notice_7_day_cure, Noncompliance),
    scenario_not_cured_within_7_days(Tenant, Noncompliance),
    statute_83_56_5a_not_waived(Landlord, Tenant, Noncompliance),
    !.

/*
  FL Stat.  83.58 (2021) - holding over after expiration without permission allows recovery
  of possession in manner provided in  83.59.
  (We include the concept of "recover possession after termination/holding over".)
*/
statute_83_58_landlord_may_recover_possession_if_holding_over(_Landlord, Tenant) :-
    % This program does not model lease expiration dates; included for completeness.
    % If we had scenario_tenant_holding_over(Tenant), we'd use it here.
    scenario_tenant_holding_over(Tenant),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning helpers (apply statutes to the scenario)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* In this program, "evict" is modeled as:
   (1) landlord has statutory right to terminate for tenant's statutory noncompliance, and
   (2) tenant remains in possession after termination conditions are satisfied.
*/
legal_landlord_may_terminate_for_statutory_tenant_obligation_violation(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    statute_83_56_2_termination_right(Landlord, Tenant, statute_83_52),
    !.

legal_landlord_may_evict_for_statutory_tenant_obligation_violation(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    legal_landlord_may_terminate_for_statutory_tenant_obligation_violation(Landlord, Tenant),
    scenario_tenant_still_in_possession(Tenant),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_landlord(L),
    scenario_tenant(T),
    legal_landlord_may_evict_for_statutory_tenant_obligation_violation(L, T),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for violating statutory tenant obligations?
